Chlorpromazine
I was prescribed Chlorpromazine more than a month ago to treat my schizoaffective personality disorder.
This month of treatment has been one of the worst, one of the things I have noticed is that everything is done slowly, my movements are slow and my speech is slow, I drag my feet when walking, I find it hard to talk, it is more difficult to think, analyze things.
Chlorpromazine causes intense and realistic dreams, it is true, but in a morbid and destructive way.
Chlorpromazine stinks, I just wait for my next appointment with my doctor so I can take this medication off of me.
